title: docs(skills): type-check more objectstack-automation examples with os:check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6mEiyfAYHpH8UmHncJB5uK)_

Refs #31112 (slice 5 of a per-skill split: item 4, objectstack-automation; the card stays open)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-automation 技能包又有 6 段 TypeScript 示例接入了示例编译检查(19 段中由 3 段变为 9 段),涵盖 notify 节点、按日期扫描的定时流程、状态机校验规则、折扣审批流程,以及两个连接器集成配方;没有发现写错的示例。
- 为什么改:AI 编写流程、审批和集成时最先照抄这些示例;接入检查后,规范一旦改名或收紧,示例会在 CI 里立刻变红,而不是悄悄教错。
- 风险与回滚:只改发布技能包的文档文字,不动任何运行时代码;四个文件的 token 上限都未抬高,新增字节靠同文件删减重复说明支付(每处删减的规则在技能包里另有出处,下文逐条列出),所有跨文件指针均保留。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`(两处新标记与三处重复句删减);其次 `references/integration-recipes.md`(配方 4、5 的标记与导入路径)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`,预期最后一行为 343 段示例全部通过类型检查。
- 需要你做的:作为受管面审批人审阅并批准本 PR(skills/** 属 Tier H)。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-automation` had 3 of its 19 fenced `ts`/`typescript` blocks under `check:skill-examples` (measured on `main` f6474306, all `*.md` outside `evals/`, `references/_index.md` excluded as generator-owned). It now has 9. Each new mark is the os:check marker on the line above the fence plus one import line; three blocks also gain a wrapper on their existing first and last lines (`const notify: FlowNode = {` … `};`, `const rule: StateMachineValidation = {` … `};`, `defineFlow({` … `});`).

| File | marked before → after / blocks | tokens before → after / ceiling | lines before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md` | 1 → 2 / 5 | 6527 → 6525 / 6527 | 452 → 452 |
| `references/examples-flows.md` | 1 → 2 / 3 | 1494 → 1490 / 1494 | 136 → 138 |
| `references/integration-recipes.md` | 0 → 2 / 6 | 2588 → 2591 / 2595 | 183 → 186 |
| `references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` | 1 → 3 / 5 | 5825 → 5810 / 5825 | 404 → 405 |

Skills bundle reading: the sum of every published `SKILL.md` does not move (4601 → 4601 lines against current `main`; this skill's `SKILL.md` is 452 → 452).

- `SKILL.md`: the `notify` node is typed `FlowNode` (`import type { FlowNode } from '@objectstack/spec/automation';`).
- `examples-flows.md`: the time-relative sweep gains `import { defineFlow } from '@objectstack/spec';` and `defineFlow(` … `)`.
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md`: the `state_machine` rule is typed `StateMachineValidation` (`@objectstack/spec/data`); the discount approval flow gains `import { cel, defineFlow } from '@objectstack/spec';` and `defineFlow(` … `)`.
- `integration-recipes.md`: recipe 4 imports `defineFlow` and recipe 5 imports `defineConnector`, both from `@objectstack/spec` (the root exports both; `@objectstack/spec/integration` also exports `defineConnector`).
- Unmarked, and why:
  - Budget, not fragments: `SKILL.md`'s trigger start node, and `integration-recipes.md`'s recipes 1 to 3. They compile with a wrapper (probed: 0 diagnostics), but the file has no room for the wrapper once every cross-reference stays. Each is byte-identical to `main`.
  - Not readable by the checker: `SKILL.md`'s two `script` blocks are fenced inside a list item (indented 3 spaces), and the checker reads column-0 fences only.
  - Fragments: `examples-flows.md`'s one-day-window `filter:` block, `state-machines-and-approvals.md`'s send-back node/edge excerpt and its three `expression` approver literals, and `integration-recipes.md`'s recipe-6 `auth:` alternatives. `state-machines-and-approvals.md` says so once in its intro. The other files have 2 to 4 tokens left and carry no note.

## Why

#31112 item 4 (ruling B of #22059): published examples are guarded by the opt-in type check. This slice brings objectstack-automation's self-contained examples under it.

### Example fixes

None. Every marked block compiled as written once its import and wrapper were added.

### Trims that paid the marks (each cut and where its rule survives)

No cross-reference is cut: every pointer to another file, section, row, skill or repository reads as on `main`.

- `SKILL.md`: "— write them right the first time" cut from the Valid-but-silently-wrong intro. No rule.
- `SKILL.md`: "(see *Inbound webhook triggers* below)" → "(*Inbound webhook triggers*)". The section name stays.
- `SKILL.md`: "§ Time-relative triggers — scheduled per-record date sweep." → "§ Time-relative triggers.". The file-and-section pointer stays, and the tail survives in the Flow Types `schedule` row ("per-record date sweep via `config.timeRelative`").
- `SKILL.md`: item 2's "Reference a field explicitly." cut. Survives in the ✅ `source: 'newRec.id'` line directly below it.
- `examples-flows.md`: "(moved verbatim from SKILL.md)" cut from the title. No rule (item 2's stub kind).
- `examples-flows.md`: the sweep's `// a sweep has no trigger user — elevate explicitly` comment cut. Survives on the first example's `runAs: 'system'` line in the same file.
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md`: "(the shipped `showcase_dynamic_approval` flow in the showcase app is this shape)" cut. The shape is the complete marked block that follows it.
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md`: "(SKILL.md § Trigger Configuration)" cut from the approval flow's start-node comment. What it points at is the start node directly under the comment.
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md`: the `// Decision branches: mutually-exclusive edge `condition` predicates.` comment cut. Survives in the same block's routing comment ("Guard every branch with a condition — see e4/e5 below") and in the e4/e5 conditions.
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md`: "(an unmarked cycle `registerFlow` rejects)" cut from the lint blockquote. Survives in Three pieces item 2 ("an **unmarked** cycle is rejected").
- `state-machines-and-approvals.md`: "Resubmit is an explicit verb (`POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/resubmit`), never a record-save." → "Resubmit is never a record-save.". The route survives in Three pieces item 1 ("ended only by `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/resubmit`") and in § Recording a decision.
- `integration-recipes.md`: "(SKILL.md's `connector_action` row)" cut. The row's substance is restated at the cut site.
- `integration-recipes.md`: the import-path bullet "`defineConnector`: `@objectstack/spec/integration`; `defineFlow`: `@objectstack/spec`; both register in `defineStack`." → "`defineConnector` and `defineFlow` register in `defineStack`.". The import paths now sit, checked, in recipes 4 and 5.
- `integration-recipes.md`: the `auth` bullet's "`basic` (`username` stays in metadata)" → "`basic`". Survives in recipe 5's marked block, which writes `username` beside `credentialRef`.

## Tests

<details><summary>check:skill-examples, before and after, the reverse check, and the pinned teaching site</summary>

- Before (`main` f6474306, run with `--keep`): `✅ 337 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.
- Probe before marking: each candidate block was written to its own file with its wrapper under the kept `.examples-build/tsconfig.json` and asked for syntactic, then semantic, diagnostics: 10 of 10 clean, with a planted unknown key on a `FlowNode` as the control (TS2353).
- After (commit b58f35ea; head e90045b1 adds only a merge of `main` touching no `skills/objectstack-automation/**` or `packages/spec` path): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exited 0 with `✅ 343 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them`.
- Reverse check at b58f35ea, after the commit, one planted wrong key per touched file: a `next` key on the notify node (`SKILL.md:122`, TS2353), a top-level `schedule` on the sweep flow (`examples-flows.md:90`, TS2353), `initialState` for `initialStates` (`state-machines-and-approvals.md:26`, TS2561), `authentication: { token }` for `auth` on the legacy-ERP connector (`integration-recipes.md:149`, TS2322). The checker exited 1 at exactly those four lines. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` were empty after.
- A first reverse run typed the state-machine block `ValidationRule`. Its planted `initialState` was NOT reported, so the block is typed by its own member, `StateMachineValidation`.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-state-route-doc-spelling.test.ts` pins `SKILL.md`'s state-introspection route line, which an earlier head had cut (CI Test Core 2/8 red). The line is restored verbatim. Red leg: the earlier `SKILL.md` gives 2 failed / 6 passed. Green leg: 8/8 at b58f35ea.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate sweep (head e90045b1)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 47 commands. 46 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package's dist; CI runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran` exited 0: 47 derived, 46 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `check:skill-examples` is not in the derived gate list for a `skills/**` diff, so it was run by hand.
- `FlowNode`'s `config` is `Record<string, unknown>` in the spec, so the `SKILL.md` mark checks the node envelope (`id`, `type`, `label`, sibling keys) and nothing inside `config`; a key typo inside a notify `config` is still caught by `NotifyConfigSchema` at `os validate`, not by this check. The same holds for node configs inside the three marked `defineFlow` blocks. `ConnectorSchema`'s `providerConfig` is also `Record<string, unknown>`, so the recipe-5 mark checks the connector envelope and the `auth` variant only, not `spec`.
- Observation, not filed: the `ValidationRule` union type does not refuse an unknown key on a `state_machine` literal (measured above), while `StateMachineValidation` does; runtime parsing still refuses it. A TypeScript author typing a rule list as `ValidationRule[]` gets no excess-key check.
- No ceiling was raised or lowered; the ratchet printed no lowering instruction.
- This build ran on the default tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates Fable for `skills/**`, and the claim records the no-Fable-build exit; the contract review is the seat's, on the lane's isolated reviewer.

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (needs `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/client-react` built) prints 343 examples green; `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0.

## Human Minimum

A governed approver reviews and approves (Tier H).
